title: Why quantum computing will break cryptocurrency by 2030

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If quantum computing breaks crypto by 2030, what will that mean for trust in digital systems?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Shor’s algorithm can crack RSA and ECC encryption, which underpin most cryptocurrencies, within a few years as quantum hardware advances.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Centralized control over digital wealth could erode financial privacy and empower authoritarian regimes to track and manipulate transactions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Post-quantum cryptography and lattice-based algorithms are being standardized now to future-proof blockchain protocols.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A quantum-safe crypto world could foster more equitable access to financial systems and protect individual freedoms globally.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The race is on—between quantum threats and quantum defenses, shaping the next era of digital trust.

video_cue: A split screen showing quantum computers on one side and secure blockchain networks on the other, with data flowing between them.
